text: He knew that in the case of all those whose army had not been obedient to command, either upon some mismanagement of an affair, fortune had deserted them, or, that upon some crime being discovered, covetousness had been clearly proved
author: Julius Caesar
speaker: Caesar
reference: Commentaries on the Gallic and Civil Wars
translation: W. A. McDevitte and W. S. Bohn, 1869
